newsitem.title: INDIA: No plan to dilute equity - India's Ambuja.
newsitem.headline: No plan to dilute equity - India's Ambuja.

text.p: Indian cement firm Gujarat Ambuja Cements Ltd has no plans to dilute equity in the next few years, its treasurer said on Thursday.

"We have no need to raise any money through equity or convertible bond issues," company treasurer Anil Singhvi told Reuters. He said talk of a global depositary issue and diversification into unrelated fields were all untrue.
"These rumours have been deliberately floated to pull down share prices," he said, referring to a fall in the firm's share prices in recent weeks.
Gujarat Ambuja share closed at 294 rupees on Thursday at the Bombay Stock Exchange, down from 311.25 rupees on September 9 and 317.50 on September 6.
"I can fund a new cement plant every year through internal accruals alone," Singhvi said.
